sentences.en: He was very scared when he saw this big snake.
sentences.zh: 当他看到这条大蛇时，他非常害怕。

sentences.en: He was very scared when he saw that large snake.

sentences.en: Even poisonous snakes will only attack if they feel threatened.
sentences.zh: 即使是有毒的蛇也只会在他感到受到威胁的时候才攻击。
